children: IDT reported record fourth-quarter and full-year fiscal 2026 results, with consolidated revenue of $339.0 million in 4Q26 and $1,297.96 million for FY2026, and consolidated gross profit of $134.8 million in 4Q26 and $496.8 million for the year. The company delivered record profitability improvements including 4Q26 income from operations of $33.2 million and FY2026 income from operations of $121.2 million, while Adjusted EBITDA rose to $41.2 million in 4Q26 and $154.6 million for FY2026. IDT's board also declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.07 per share payable October 14, 2026.
Consolidated revenue: $339.0 million in 4Q26 (up 7% year-over-year); $1,297.96 million for FY2026 (up 5% year-over-year).
Gross profit and margin: $134.8 million and 39.8% in 4Q26 (gross profit +18% YoY, margin +360 bps); $496.8 million and 38.3% for FY2026 (gross profit +11% YoY, margin +200 bps).
Income from operations: $33.2 million in 4Q26 (up 52% YoY); $121.17 million for FY2026 (up 21% YoY).
Net income attributable to IDT: $21.7 million in 4Q26 (up 29% YoY); $86.63 million for FY2026 (up 14% YoY).

Adjusted diluted EPS (Non-GAAP): $0.94 in 4Q26 (up from $0.76); Non-GAAP EPS $3.82 for FY2026 (up from $3.19). Adjusted EBITDA: $41.2 million in 4Q26 (up 22% YoY); $154.6 million for FY2026 (up 17% YoY).

NRS expanded its retailer network and offerings: retailer locations reached 35,400 with active POS terminals of 40,400; Merchant Services and Advertising & Data drove strong revenue growth and average monthly gross profit per location rose to $383 in 4Q26 (up 22% YoY).

BOSS Money accelerated digital adoption: digital channel accounted for 88% of transactions in 4Q26, total BOSS Money transactions reached 7.5 million in the quarter (digital transactions +20% YoY), and BOSS Money launched WhatsApp transfers and a U.S. digital wallet.

net2phone continued subscription growth and product enhancements: seats were 447k at quarter end, subscription revenue $24.5 million in 4Q26 (up 10% YoY; +7% constant currency), and new integration layer and AI-powered solutions broadening enterprise capabilities.

Traditional Communications maintained scale and cash generation: revenue of $222.0 million in 4Q26 with increased Adjusted EBITDA contribution; IDT Digital Payments expanded offerings with an eSIM catalog for travel data roaming.

Balance sheet and cash flows: unrestricted cash, cash equivalents, debt securities and current equity investments totaled $271.9 million at July 31, 2026; company reported no outstanding debt at quarter end and completed share repurchases during FY2026.
